Method of Attack: Execution of arbitrary commands on the underlying system
Impacted Systems: Unified Communications Manager IM & Presence Service (versions 11.5(1), 12.5(1), and 14)
Unified Communications Manager Session Management Edition (versions 11.5, 12.5(1), and 14)
Unified Contact Center Express (versions 12.0 and earlier and 12.5(1))
Virtualized Voice Browser (versions 12.0 and earlier, 12.5(1), and 12.5(2))
Attack Vector: Sending a specially crafted message to a listening port of a susceptible appliance
